reasoning: This is Meta's Llama Stack, a service framework that exposes AI/ML capabilities through a FastAPI server. It provides API endpoints for inference, agents, safety, eval, scoring, vector I/O, and more. The project includes: (1) a FastAPI-based server (llama_stack/distribution/server/server.py) with auth, routing, and quota management; (2) a comprehensive API layer defining protocols for inference, agents, benchmarks, datasets, post-training, safety, etc.; (3) a pluggable provider system with inline and remote provider implementations; (4) a CLI ('llama' command) for building, configuring, and running server instances; (5) distribution tooling for container and venv builds. It is classified as a 'service' because its primary purpose is to run as a long-lived server process exposing HTTP APIs for AI model inference and orchestration.
